5.name: Episode 1
5.overview: A year after Ruby's kidnapping, Rosario and El Ángel keep a low profile, but Rosario can't help but come across trouble — and enemies.

5.name: Episode 2
5.overview: Rosario gets a life-changing surprise, but her new guest has an agenda of their own. As Juan Antonio moves on, a new enemy enters the fold.

5.name: Episode 3
5.overview: Chaos reigns over Tijuana as El Ángel and Rosario are forced on the run, and Adrián enters into a devious deal. A new crowd takes over the city.

5.name: Episode 4
5.overview: As Arteaga's crew marks their territory, residents of Los Héroes push back. With Fredy's life on the line, Rosario pressures Ruby to tell her the truth.

5.name: Episode 5
5.overview: Fredy's deal with El Sagrado puts Rosario in danger. After his crew's spree, Arteaga brings in backup, but tensions erupt. A call puts Adrián in a bind.

5.name: Episode 6
5.overview: Rosario suffers a personal betrayal, as El Ángel desperately searches for her and Ruby. Chinche is on the run. Arteaga's vile plan comes to fruition.

5.name: Episode 7
5.overview: A long-awaited confrontation turns violent for Rosario as Adrián sinks under the weight of his debt, but a suggestion turns his sights to Juan Antonio.

5.name: Episode 8
5.overview: Rosario is used as a pawn in Arteaga's schemes, using a very special weapon. El Ángel faces his traitors, and Adrián's fear holds Lucía back.

5.name: Episode 9
5.overview: A phone call alerts Pelao to Rosario's whereabouts as she closes in on Arteaga's target. Ruby makes a decision that pulls her away from Billy.

5.name: Episode 10
5.overview: Juan Antonio is questioned about his past. Ruby schemes to buy Rosario more time, but it's not easy when her mother's morals get in the way.

5.name: Episode 11
5.overview: Escalante's funeral is attended by everyone – including Rosario, who refuses to kill Pavel. A shootout claims lives and frees others.

5.name: Episode 12
5.overview: Ruby and Pelao meet, setting Arteaga's new plan in motion. Lucía accepts her new position, and Rosario and Juan Antonio try to deactivate a bomb.

5.name: Episode 13
5.overview: Chucky helps Rosario secure passage to Tijuana, but Concepción sets up a police roadblock. Nueva Sangre head out to free El Ángel.

5.name: Episode 14
5.overview: Juan Antonio helps Rosario get to Tijuana, but a close call with Nueva Sangre puts everything in jeopardy. The group offers El Sagrado a trade.

5.name: Episode 15
5.overview: Fredy and Arthur fall for a trap. Pelao refuses to help Ruby, but she has a plan. Rosario infiltrates El Sagrado's estate to rescue El Ángel.

5.name: Episode 16
5.overview: Nueva Sangre's deception of El Sagrado leads to a shootout, which Rosario uses to her own advantage. A rescue mission turns into a race against death.

5.name: Episode 17
5.overview: Arteaga suspects a traitor within Nueva Sangre and sets out to find the culprit. Rosario and Juan Antonio hide El Ángel, who is on the verge of death.

5.name: Episode 18
5.overview: When Rosario tells Pelao the truth about Nueva Sangre and Ruby, the two form a plan. Mireya gives Rosario information about Western Towers.

5.name: Episode 19
5.overview: Pelao tells Rosario about Chinche's scheme, and she uses it to her advantage. Dulce stops Kim from leaving the cartel as Juan Antonio investigates.

5.name: Episode 20
5.overview: Rosario strikes a deal with the Americans: Chinche for information about Arteaga. Mireya gives Juan Antonio details about the Western Towers project.

5.name: Episode 21
5.overview: A party gives Pelao the perfect opportunity to give Rosario the proof she needs. The Americans agree to Rosario's deal, and they send Arteaga a surprise.

5.name: Episode 22
5.overview: Having survived the explosion, Arteaga is set on revenge. Rosario kidnaps Chinche with Mireya's help, and Ántrax is captured by Lucía.

5.name: Episode 23
5.overview: Billy convinces Arteaga to go into hiding at the Casa del Olmo, and Rosario finds out. Kim points the finger, and one of the Nueva Sangre is killed.

5.name: Episode 24
5.overview: A cat-and-mouse chase sparks a declaration of war for mother and daughter. With no leader, infighting threatens Nueva Sangre as guilt overtakes Kim.

5.name: Episode 25
5.overview: The Americans crash a funeral, and Ruby makes Arteaga an oath. Rosario plans her next movie, to Juan Antonio's dismay. Pelao gets territorial.

5.name: Episode 26
5.overview: Nueva Sangre's rampage through Los Héroes forces Rosario's hand. A vote ends badly for Ruby, and Pelao passes Dulce's test. Rosario finds weapons.

5.name: Episode 27
5.overview: Dulce's takeover of Nueva Sangre isn't without bloodshed – or mishaps. Ántrax throws Lucía off, and Rosario targets Nueva Sangre's weaponry.

5.name: Episode 28
5.overview: Nueva Sangre strikes back at Mireya and Los Héroes, but Dulce's power gets weaker. As Rosario desperately tries to free them, the clock runs out.

5.name: Episode 29
5.overview: The massacre of Los Héroes puts Adrián in the hot seat. Ruby gains valuable intel, and Lucía questions Juan Antonio about Rosario. Pelao asks to come.

5.name: Episode 30
5.overview: Rosario trains the survivors of Los Héroes as Juan Antonio starts counseling sessions. Ruby hides a secret, and Rosario gets a wake-up call.

5.name: Episode 31
5.overview: With El Ángel awake, Rosario faces her biggest challenge yet. Ruby calms Adrián after Lucía's close call. Dulce's hold over Nueva Sangre grows weaker.

5.name: Episode 32
5.overview: Lucía seeks Rosario as Ruby works to depose Dulce as Nueva Sangre's leader, while El Ángel grows more suspicious of Rosario and Juan Antonio.

5.name: Episode 33
5.overview: As Lucía prepares a criminal investigation against Adrián, he makes a drastic choice on Ruby's orders. Rosario makes Lucía an offer.

5.name: Episode 34
5.overview: El Ángel forces Pelao to organize a meeting with Ruby. Lucía and armed guards crash Adrián's engagement party. Ruby gets what she needs from Adrián.

5.name: Episode 35
5.overview: El Ángel confronts Rosario and goes after Juan Antonio. Adrián starts a war with Lucía, and Dulce makes her move against Ruby, but Pelao calls back-up.

5.name: Episode 36
5.overview: One person's end becomes another's beginning as Ruby and El Ángel reunite. Father and daughter work together to rebuild Nueva Sangre.

5.name: Episode 37
5.overview: Rosario and El Ángel find themselves at odds, as Nueva Sangre discovers it's bankrupt. Lucía's reputation takes a hit after an edited audio is leaked.

5.name: Episode 38
5.overview: Juan Antonio gets a surprise visitor, and Rosario makes a choice with a price. El Ángel meets with the Americans as Ruby betrays an old friend.

5.name: Episode 39
5.overview: El Ángel's plan to calmly subdue Los Héroes threatens Ruby, who executes her own plan. Rosario walks into an outright street war.

5.name: Episode 40
5.overview: After the Los Héroes massacre, El Ángel sees Ruby's true face. A bloody family reunion leaves a trail of bodies and two futures hanging in the balance

overview: Worlds collide when a vengeance-obsessed young woman from the other side of the tracks captures the attention of two well-off friends.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: Worlds collide when a vengeance-obsessed young woman from the other side of the tracks captures the attention of two well-off friends.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: While on the run, Rosario is separated from the love of her life. As she tries desperately to reunite with him, danger is around every corner.

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Rosario is forced to work with the police to capture El Ángel after her 5-year-old daughter, Ruby, is kidnapped.

title: Rosario Tijeras (Mexico)
